findings.title: Embedded post author link color uses inverted light/dark lightness values
findings.body: The old rule was `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`, but the replacement is `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`. This changes the light-scheme color from 30% to 70% and gives the dark scheme 30% instead of the complementary 70%. The `.embedded-posts .topic-meta-data h5 a` link becomes washed out in light themes and too dark/low-contrast in dark themes. It should likely be `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`.

findings.title: Custom message length color uses inverted light/dark lightness values
findings.body: The old rule was `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)`, but the replacement is `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`. The light and dark arguments are swapped: the light theme now uses 30% instead of 70%, and the dark theme uses 70% instead of the expected 30%. This reverses the intended contrast for `.custom-message-length`. It should likely be `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`.

findings.title: Topic map h3 color changed from 20% to 50% lightness
findings.body: The old rule was `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%)`, but the replacement is `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`. The light-scheme value should remain 20%, and the dark-scheme value should be 80%, as done for the equivalent desktop rule. The new value reduces light-theme contrast and gives dark themes a less distinct heading color.

findings.title: Group member name color changed from 30% to 50% lightness
findings.body: The old rule was `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`, but the replacement is `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`. The light-scheme value should remain 30%, and the dark-scheme value should be 70%. The new values reduce contrast for `.group-member-info .name` in both themes.

findings.title: Group member name color changed from 30% to 50% lightness
findings.body: The old rule was `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`, but the replacement is `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`. The light-scheme value should remain 30%, and the dark-scheme value should be 70%. The new values reduce contrast for `.group-member-info .name` in both themes.

findings.title: Missed dark-light-choose conversion for category badge notification
findings.body: This rule still uses `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%)` even though the rest of this PR converts equivalent `scale-color($primary, ...)` text/border colors to `dark-light-choose(..., scale-color($secondary, ...))`. As a result, `.topic-list.categories .category .badge-notification` still derives its color from `$primary` in dark themes, leaving an inconsistent color in the modified file.
